mapper.sql: CAST(id AS CHAR) id,order_no orderNo,booker_name bookerName,booker_phone bookerPhone,status,room_count roomCount,room_type_name_snapshot roomTypeName,DATE_FORMAT(planned_checkin_time,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+08:00') plannedCheckinTime,DATE_FORMAT(planned_checkout_time,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+08:00') plannedCheckoutTime,nights,CAST(nightly_price AS CHAR) nightlyPrice,CAST(total_amount AS CHAR) totalAmount,remark,DATE_FORMAT(cancel_time,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+08:00') cancelTime,cancel_reason cancelReason,(SELECT rt.max_guests FROM room_type rt WHERE rt.id=booking_order.room_type_id) maxGuests
mapper.select: SELECT FROM booking_order WHERE ORDER BY create_time DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM booking_order WHERE id=#{id} AND is_deleted=0

SELECT CAST(c.room_id AS CHAR) roomId,c.room_no_snapshot roomNo,DATE_FORMAT(c.checkin_time,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+08:00') checkinTime,g.guest_seq guestSeq,g.guest_name name,g.phone FROM checkin_record c JOIN checkin_guest g ON g.checkin_id=c.id AND g.is_deleted=0 WHERE c.order_id=#{id} AND c.is_deleted=0 ORDER BY c.room_id,g.guest_seq

SELECT o.nights-COUNT(i.id) FROM booking_order o LEFT JOIN room_type_inventory i ON i.room_type_id=o.room_type_id AND i.stay_date >= DATE(o.planned_checkin_time) AND i.stay_date < DATE(o.planned_checkout_time) AND i.is_deleted=0 WHERE o.id=#{id} GROUP BY o.id

SELECT CAST(d.room_id AS CHAR) roomId,d.room_no roomNo,r.floor_label floorLabel FROM booking_order o JOIN room_type_inventory i ON i.room_type_id=o.room_type_id AND i.stay_date >= DATE(o.planned_checkin_time) AND i.stay_date < DATE(o.planned_checkout_time) AND i.is_deleted=0 JOIN room_inventory_detail d ON d.inventory_id=i.id AND d.room_type_id=o.room_type_id AND d.is_deleted=0 AND d.status='ACTIVE' AND d.is_occupied=0 AND d.checkin_record_id IS NULL JOIN room r ON r.id=d.room_id AND r.room_type_id=o.room_type_id AND r.room_no=d.room_no AND r.is_deleted=0 AND r.physical_status='READY' WHERE o.id=#{id} AND o.status='PENDING' AND o.is_deleted=0 GROUP BY o.id,o.nights,d.room_id,d.room_no,r.floor_label HAVING COUNT(*)=o.nights ORDER BY d.room_no
